batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c BJ Hodge b SK Trivedi

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c DT Christian b A Mishra

batting.name: AL Menaria
batting.dismissal: c JP Duminy b A Mishra

batting.name: OA Shah

batting.name: J Botha
batting.dismissal: c T Mishra b Anand Rajan

balls.text: a bit short and he flat-bats it down to long-on, one bounce, he collides with the keeper but safely completes the two
20 within reach! Good length on the off stump and he gets on his knee and slogs him over deep midwicket
Duminy justifies his inclusion with a fifty! Picks a length delivery on middle and carves it over the bowler's head
another swing and a miss, looked close to the edge
poor delivery, short and wide outside off and Duminy chases that and gets a thick outside edge that clears short third man
goes for another heave but misses, Yagnik who up to the stumps whips off the bails
mows it down to deep midwicket for a single
tries to smash that over the leg side but misses
Pankaj tries to compensate with an attempted yorker, ends up being a low full toss and Duminy gets under that and slams it over the bowler's head
Duminy gives him the charge and goes downtown, lofts that really high and clears long-on
gets forward and forces it down to long-off
slower delivery and it's short, he makes room and slaps it wide of sweeper cover and finds the big gap
this time he splits the gap at fine leg, on he pads and clipped away and it's wide of the fielder

that's followed by an ordinary effort at short fine leg, Pankaj dived at short fine leg but let it slip through, great effort at the boundary by Rahane but he made contact with the rope as he pulled it back
hammers it down to long-on and Menaria does really well to slide and cut it off
comes down the track and heaves it down to deep midwicket to bring up the 150
fuller delivery and driven firmly but can't beat cover
that's the wrong line and length, slower ball short and wide outside off and Christian stays back and slaps it wide of sweeper cover
full outside off and bashed down the ground to long-off
down the track and he whams a full toss back to the bowler, lucky escape for Hogg
on the pads and clipped down to deep midwicket
on the pads and worked down to deep midwicket
effortless! Comes down the track to Hogg, comes to the pitch and lofts him crisply over the bowler's head, flat six
nearly drags this onto his stumps, tucked him up for room there
that's a clean shot! Friendly length delivery on the middle stump and he's on his knee and slogs him cleanly over deep midwicket
exposes his stumps and tries the sweep but the ball lobs off his pads and clears the keeper
Duminy swipes across the line and lucky for him the ball drops short of long-on
on the pads and he clips him wide of square leg
chases the angle away from the left-hander and dabs it down to third man
poor delivery, he drifts wide down the leg side and Yagnik dives and can't pouch it, deflects wide of short fine leg
goes back and punches it to the off side

pretty comical in the end, Christian used his feet and lofted it towards long-off and Shah did well to slide and stop it with his right hand, he relayed the throw to Rahane who over-ran the ball and in the end Rahane had to turn around and pick it up at long-off - his original position
punches it down to sweeper cover
would have been a superb catch, Christian gets a top edge on the sweep and Dravid sprints to his left at short fine leg but the ball beats him comfortably
skids through and he clips him down to deep midwicket
goes back, makes room and slaps him down to sweeper cover
full outside off and he forces it down to deep midwicket
tries to cut but he ends up chopping it down towards the keeper
stays back and punches it back to the bowler
moves away from him and he's beaten
they've got their danger man! Dhawan gets on his knee to swipe him across the line, he doesn't get the distance and Hodge sprints to his right from deep square leg and takes it well
terrible delivery down the leg side, Christian tries to pull but fails to make proper contact
straightens and deflects off his thigh pad to third man and Botha appeals confidently for an lbw, that was missing off
skids through and clips his pads as he tries to clip it away
flatter delivery and he punches it down to long-on
goes back at the crease and works it down to deep square leg
chips down the track and drives on the up back to the bowler
goes back and pulls another googly down to deep midwicket
tucks it down to fine leg and that's Dhawan's fifty
can't blame the bowler for that, the skiddy chinaman, Dhawan was squared up at the crease and got a thick inside edge that trickled past the stumps and down to fine leg
full on the pads and squeezed out to midwicket
gets forward and drives him straight to long-off
driven just wide of Rahane and long-off picks it up
goes back and punches it on the up to long-off
4,6 and out! Sangakkara gets on his knee and tries to slog that but gets a tame top edge that's taken easily by Yagnik, lucky comeback by Hodge since Sangakkara was looking dangerous
a repeat and he goes further! Down the track and to the pitch of the ball and lofted over long-on
makes room uses his feet and chips down the track and lofts him down to long-on
skids through and he punches it firmly to long-off
goes back and it spins inwards sharply and he mistimes the pull to square leg
comes down the track and forces a low full toss down to long-on
chips down the track and drives a full delivery down to long-off
fuller delivery and clipped down to deep midwicket
a bit short and spinning away, he stays back and slaps it down to deep cover
goes back at the crease and punches it back to the bowler firmly
bangs it in short and he swivels and pulls down to deep midwicket
stays back and punches it down to mid-off
talk about placement! Slower delivery outside off, follows the width and deftly angles it through the gap wide of short third man
goes back and punches it down to long-on
punched on the up but mistimed back to the bowler
this time he gets the reverse sweep spot on, premeditated, picks a full one outside off and places it wide of short third man
he goes back and makes room and punches him firmly down to mid-off
attempts the reverse sweep and Botha was appealing for a lbw, hitting him outside off
spins away and he punches it wide of long-off
the wrong 'un shoots back in and the batsman nearly drags it onto his stumps!
tossed up outside off and he gets down the track and drives to long-off
gets forward and drives it down to long-off
drifts down the leg side and Trivedi can thank his lucky stars Dravid was there at short fine leg to save a certain four
slower delivery and he punches it back to the bowler
very firmly driven down to mid-off and no chance for a single there
makes the mistake of drifting on the pads and he clips it to the massive gap on the leg side, fine leg had no chance
on middle stump line and clipped to the on side, comfortable start here for Deccan
comes forward and drops it towards cover and sets off for a quick single
short and mistimes the pull to short fine leg but Dhawan was quick off the blocks at the other end
Sangakkara uses his feet and gets down the pitch, makes room and hammers it wide of mid-on,top shot
goes back and clips him towards midwicket for a single
drifts on the pads and he clips it to the on side
spins away and he punches it wide of mid-off
on the body and clipped down to Trivedi at short fine leg
Sangakkara shuffled at the crease before delivery and smacked a length ball in the air but safely wide of mid-off
punches it just wide of mid-on for an easy single
a bit too straight and he tucks it down to short fine leg
keeps it short to Sangakkara as well and he pulls it in the air down to deep square leg
bowls it a bit short and he pulls him down to deep square leg
and it finally ends, on the off stump and punched down to mid-on
this over's never ending, another wide down the leg side
driven firmly and well stopped by Trivedi at mid-off, saved three runs
punches it down the track and can't pinch a single
short and down the leg side, not the best line to bowl with the fine leg up, easily pulled to long leg, another gift from the bowler
slower delivery back of a length and easily pulled down to deep square leg
down the leg side and the keeper Yagnik and Amit thought it clipped his bat
he gives him the charge and swishes at thin air, slightly slower delivery
terrible delivery down the leg side especially with the keeper up to the stumps, Sangtakkara tries to pull but it was too much for Yagnik
driven firmly back to the bowler
you can't bowl it short and wide on this pitch, another error by Botha, Dhawan was back at the crease and cut it past point easily
uses his feet and pushes it firmly down to mid-on
punched on the up but it drops short of the bowler
goes down the track and drives towards mid-off
half tracker outside off, loose delivery, gave the batsman enough time to rock back and slap it past the covers
the timing was amazing! Angling across the left-hander, it was just a defensive push to the off side but Rahane at backward point realised in due course he wasn't going to cut that off
slower delivery and he tucks it firmly towards midwicket
full and wide outside the off stump and driven firmly but Menaria's there at cover to slide and cut it off
drifts too wide down the leg side, fails to make contact with that
tucked away towards midwicket but no opportunity for a single this time
easily done again, softly worked wide of mid-on and the calling is good, they get through easily
clipped with soft hands towards mid-on and calls early for the single
that's a classic cut, Pankaj gives him width and Dhawan slices it past backward point and cover, didn't hit it too hard
dropped with soft hands to the off side and sends his partner back
goes back and steers it towards point
Appeal for a run-out! Pushed to short cover, they risk the single and Menaria's one-handed pick up and throw hits the stumps but Dhawan's just in, third umpire takes a look
driven on the up but wide of the bowler and down to mid-on
not a bad way to shake off a week's break! Friendly delivery on the pads and easily whipped to the fine leg region

the relatively unknown Yagnik's done it! Steyn bowls that fuller and still too wide, Yagnik makes room and crashes it past the diving cover fielder, the sweeper tries to cut it off but the ball beats him
he knocks off four of them! Steyn fires that a touch too wide, he has the width to smack that past the off side field and down to deep cover
low full toss and Hodge clears the front leg and clips it in the air down to deep midwicket, just a single
Steyn bowls that full and wide and Hodge makes room and slaps that to sweeper cover, fires in the throw and they scamper two
makes room and slaps that down to long-on, settles for the strike
add six more! Slower ball outside the off stump and Hodge makes room and whams that over wide long-off
heads up , that's a beamer! Slipped out and Hodge just about moves away, Rajan apologises
Hodge makes room and slams that in the air down the ground to long-on, the fielder at long-on dives in vain
slower ball and he thuds it down to long-off
good, full delivery and he can only slam it down to long-off

the catch sticks this time alright! Huge relief for Deccan, Botha sizes up to swing that over midwicket, slower ball, goes a long way up in the air but well short of the rope, vital catch by Tanmay Mishra
squeezes a full delivery to the off side and that's 13 off the over
The Royals are catching up quickly! Feeds him a slower ball bowled on a length and he has a free swing and carts that rows back over deep midwicket
good inswinging yorker, gets an inside edge to his boot and the ball deflects to the keeper, they scamper a quick single
slower delivery and worked down to the on side
goes back at the crease and mistimes the pull to midwicket
Dropped, Chipli this time! He makes room and splices it over point and Chipli pedals back and spills it
four consecutive fours! Steyn makes the mistake of bowling a half volley, he makes room and smashes that past extra cover, Hodge exploiting the pace of the ball to fetch the boundaries
make that three in three! He bowls it shorter and Hodge makes room and cuts that over the vacant slips region, even third man can't stop it
Steyn makes the mistake of bowling a low full toss on the leg stump, Hodge easily turns it away to deep square leg
crisp cut! Short and wide outside off and he was on the front foot to cut, picked the gap wide of backward point
slower ball on the stumps and worked down to long-on
tries to cut but he's beaten
misfield! Hodge cuts a delivery to the off side and the fielder at point makes a mess of it, it was Chipli and Mishra of course wasn't pleased
drives to long-on
pitched that really really short and the batsman couldn't club it away, along the ground to midwicket
quicker and flatter and punched down to long-on
well the drop doesn't cost the Chargers that much! Tries to slog one from the off stump, on his knee and he nearly gets the distance, Jhunjhunwala takes it just in front of the rope at deep midwicket
goes back and slaps it with the turn to the off side
Steyn's dropped it! Oh dear will that cost the Chargers? Shah made room to slog and miscued it towards wide long-on, Steyn went across to his right and spilled a regulation catch
take cover! Flighted on middle and leg and slogged a few rows over deep midwicket
makes a lot of room and slaps it to the bowler who fumbles
goes back at the crease and thumps it down to sweeper cover
gets forward and stabs it back to the bowler
spins away and he shapes to drive but misses, beaten by the turn
tucks it down to square leg
drives it just wide of Mishra
gets forward and pushes it down the ground
The Chargers pull things back with this wicket, Rahane uses his feet and makes room to go downtown over long-off, doesn't quite control it and lands safely down Christian's throat
wide outside off and it spins away, wide called
bowls it flat and full and he gives the charge and squeezes it just wide of the bowler
skids through and he';s beaten as he tries to cut
tossed up and he flicks it to deep square leg for a single
gives himself a lot of room even before the delivery and slices him wide of point and cover, despairing dive by the sweeper
down the leg side and Shah withdraws the shot at the last ,minute
down the pitch and worked to long-on and he tells his partner to run two immediately
bowls it really short and he has to really stretch to fetch that from outside off
soft dismissal! Flatter delivery and Menaria rocks back to club that over the on side, mistimes it and ends up pulling to Duminy at short midwicket
works it down to long-on for a single
stays back, waits for the turn and punches him to deep cover
tossed up on middle and leg and he gets on his knee and slogs him flat and hard over deep midwicket
gets forward and works it down to long-on
textbook on-drive past the bowler down to long-on, showed the full face of the bat
clips it towards deep midwicket to bring up the 100 for the Royals
that should take some pressure off Menaria, short and wide and he has the width to slap that off the back foot wide of sweeper cover
stays back and clips him down to long-on
lovely shot! Half volley outside off and he makes a bit of room and carves him over extra cover, picks the gap perfectly
full and wide outside off and driven to sweeper cover
full and wide outside off and he drives straight to sweeper cover, the pressure must be getting to Menaria a bit
bowls it short and flat and Rahane rocks back and works it to midwicket
something like that, Rahane takes a few paces down the track, makes room and launches him just over wide long-off's reach
drags it a bit short and he pulls off the front foot, Royals need boundaries here
stays at the crease and punches it with the turn to long-off
keeps a bit low and he stays back and clips him down to deep midwicket
ends the over with a sharp bouncer that has Rahane weaving away, good over from Steyn
squares him up at the crease and he steers it down to point
doesn't crank up his pace, Rahane gently works it down to third man
drifts on the pads and he works it away down to fine leg
Steyn beats Menaria for pace, outside off and he';s beaten as he tries to dab it to the off side
bowls it outside off, he opens the face of the bat and angles it to third man
good finish to the over, bangs it in short and angles it across the left-hander, he can only leave it to the keeper
fullish on the pads and he works it down to deep square leg
bangs it in short and he pulls but wasn't in full control of the shot, it's miscued but lands in front of deep midwicket
outside off and he deliberately angles it down to third man
inside edge to the pads and the ball deflects to the off side, they set off quickly
beats him outside the off stump as he tries to angle it to the off side
stand and deliver! Length ball outside off and Rahane's in such princely form that he merely punches it over the bowler's head, timing was crisp
good calling, dropped with soft hands in front of the keeper and sets off
risks a single, he was down the track before pushing it to mid-off and he was home before the direct hit at the bowler's end
short of a length and tucks him up and he tucks him straight to midwicket
full and wide outside the off stump and driven down to sweeper cover
stays back and clips him down to square leg
slashes at one outside off and he misses
Christian gets the captain! He bowls the slower ball on the pads, Dravid makes room and tries to work it away to the on side bu the ball deflects off his pads and pegs back the leg stump
slides that too wide down the leg side
Dravid continues to lead nby example, short and wide and he stands tall and punches that wide of extra cover for yet another four
good comeback by the bowler, bangs it in short and Dravid weaves away to avoid it
take that! Full and wide outside off and Dravid chases that and carves him inside out over deep extra cover, Dravid 2.0 here
nicely punched off the back foot but straight to short extra cover
drops it with soft hands to the on side and sets off quickly
outside edge and no slip! Chases a wide one and the edge flies past Sanga who dives in despair
down the leg side and Sangakkara was confident he nicked that but wide called
he didn't seem in full control of that but it made no difference to the outcome, he chipped down the track to smash it down the ground but checked the shot, still had enough to beat mid-off
keeps it nice and straight and he punches it back down the track
tough chance! Spooned to Rajan's left and he sticks his left hand out and can't hold on to it
punches it down to cover for a single
now he drifts on the pads and he clips him away down to fine leg, electric start for the Royals
he gives him the charge and clubs a length delivery through midwicket, Rahane's disturbing the bowler's length here
punches it to the off side for a single
Dravid improvises by making room early, punches a short delivery against the angle of the delivery and beats cover
back of a length and Dravid punches it down to the off side
drags it down to mid-on for a single
comes down the track and lofts him down to long-off
tucks it down to short fine leg and can't pinch a single
comes forward and tucks it down to mid-on
goes back and clips it with the turn to deep midwicket
he drops it short and Rahane quickly goes deep at the crease and hammers it over mid-on, he's in top form
Steyn concedes 12 in one over - the same over 4 in the previous game - Dravid chases one outside off and deliberately edges it past slip
hits a good length on the stumps and he knocks it back to the bowler
Dravid pulls! Short and comes on to him really quick and he clubs it down to long leg and just beats the fielder
short and wide and Steyn gets away with it as the batsman chops it down to cover
lands it outside off and he safely leaves it alone
he uses the pace of Steyn to reach out and gets a thick outside edge that flies to third man, the fielder dives but can't stop it
mistimes the drive to midwicket, good first over
goes back and punches it just wide of the bowler and down to mid-on
gets forward and drops it back to the bowler
comes well forward and drives him to long-off
misfield! Turned to short fine leg and the fielder makes a mess of it
turn and bounce straightaway! Really foxes Dravid outside off
